{{Top}} {{Character |type=Galactic Empire |image=[[File:Mayday-TBB.png]] |option1=Face |image2=[[File:MaydayArmor-Outpost.png]] |option2=Helmet |name=Mayday |homeworld=[[Kamino]]{{Databank|clone-troopers|Clone Troopers}} — Based on corresponding biographical and physical details for all [[clone trooper]]s. |birth=Kamino |death=During or after [[18 BBY]],{{TBBDate|212}} [[Barton IV]]{{TBB|The Outpost}} |species=[[Human]] {{C|[[Cloning|clone]]}} |gender= |pronouns=He/him |donor=[[Jango Fett]] |height=1.83 [[meter]]s (6 [[Foot|ft]]) |mass=80 [[kilogram]]s{{Topps|set=2015 Topps Star Wars Chrome Perspectives|subset=Jedi Temple Archives|cardname=Clone Troopers|link=https://www.tcdb.com/ViewCard.cfm/sid/114595/cid/8022627/2015-Topps-Chrome-Star-Wars-Perspectives-Jedi-vs.-Sith-23-J-Clone-Troopers}} — Based on corresponding data for [[Cloning|clones]] of [[Jango Fett]] |hair=[[Color|Dark brown]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Tan |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic]] **[[Grand Army of the Republic]] *[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Mayday's squad]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|The name's Mayday.|Mayday, to Crosshair|}} '''Mayday''' was the name of a [[Clone Commander]] who was stationed on the icy [[planet]] [[Barton IV]] during the [[Imperial Era]]. At some point, he and [[Crosshair|CT-9904]] "Crosshair" were tasked by [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant]] [[Nolan]] with recovering Imperial supplies that had been stolen by local bandits. The mission ended up being unsuccessful but Crosshair refused to abandon his brother. In an attempt to save Mayday from the injuries he had sustained from an avalanche, Crosshair brought him back to the planet's [[Imperial Depot (Barton IV)|Imperial depot]], despite the freezing conditions they both had to endure. However, Mayday was denied medical support by Nolan and died in front of a helpless Crosshair, an act which caused Crosshair to desert from the Empire. ==Biography== ===Assigned to Barton IV=== {{Quote|I've been stationed on this rock for over a year watching that cargo. Now that it's finally getting transported, me and my squad can hopefully get out of here.|Mayday|}} Mayday was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[extragalactic]][[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']] [[planet]] [[Kamino]], as a [[Bioengineering|genetic]] [[Cloning|clone]] of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]], and as such was enlisted into [[Galactic Republic]] service, as a [[clone trooper]] and [[Clone Commander]]{{Databank|clone-commander-mayday|Clone Commander Mayday}} in their [[Grand Army of the Republic|ground forces]], fighting for them in the [[Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Dedicated to serving as a Republic [[soldier]], in [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' Mayday and the other clone troopers received direct orders from [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]]. In accordance with [[Order 66]]''[[Collapse of the Republic]]'' establishes that every [[clone trooper]], which includes Mayday, received [[Order 66]] to [[Great Jedi Purge|exterminate]] the [[Jedi Order]]. and enforced by [[behavioral modification biochip]]s,''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' the clone [[army]] was commanded to [[Great Jedi Purge|exterminate]] the [[Jedi Order]], as they were branded [[Treason|traitors]] to the Republic state. Not long after, the Clone Wars had abruptly ceased and the Republic was [[Proclamation of the New Order|reorganized]] by the Chancellor into the [[Galactic Empire]].{{TBB|Aftermath (episode)}} Following the transition, the clone troopers continued their military service with the Empire, as [[stormtrooper]]s{{Databank|stormtroopers|Stormtroopers}} of the [[Imperial Army]]. Clone service was, however, to be eventually retired with a cost-effective [[Imperial Military|military]] of [[TK stormtrooper|conscripted soldiers]], formed from the passing of the [[Imperial Defense Recruitment Bill|Defense Recruitment Bill]] in the [[Imperial Senate]].{{TBB|Truth and Consequences}} Although clones were gradually being replaced, Mayday was dispatched with a [[Mayday's squad|squad]] of troopers to the [[Water|snow]]-covered planet [[Barton IV]], to defend a critical [[Imperial Depot (Barton IV)|supply depot]] and secure storage of important shipments, crucial to the Imperial Military. Attacked continuously by local [[Unidentified raiders|raiders]], the [[commander]] filed requests for equipment such as replacement [[sensor beacon]]s, as they had degraded in the planetary conditions and he had presumed the raiders were bypassing them. With all of his requests going unanswered by the Empire, still ordered to protect the cargo unwaveringly, Mayday was forced to improvise in certain situations against the raiders. ===Arrival of reinforcements=== {{Quote|Conditions have degraded our equipment. I requested replacements but got none. Yet we're told to protect the cargo at all costs.''"
"''Why? What's inside those crates?''"
"''Hmm. Yeah, I've wondered that myself every day.|Mayday to Crosshair|}} [[File:MaydaysSquad-TheOutpost.png|left|thumb|280px|Mayday, Hexx, and Veetch were the only men left in the outpost.]] During or after [[18 BBY]], the attacks from the raiders had begun to progress, with recent ambushes catching the Imperial troopers off-guard. Left with only himself and two other troopers—[[Hexx]] and [[Veetch]]—and memorializing the [[Death|fallen]] with their [[helmet]]s, Mayday transmitted a request for reinforcements on Barton IV. After thirty-six [[Local day|rotations]] had passed on the ice-covered world, Imperial [[Lieutenant]] [[Nolan]] was dispatched from the [[capital]] planet [[Coruscant]] with four clone troopers to assist Mayday, one of whom was [[clone commando]] [[Crosshair|CT-9904]]. Though the quarry remained in Imperial possession, Nolan declared his{{TBB|The Outpost}} {{AD|Disney+}} displeasure with Mayday's failures in defending the depot and his command over the operation, while the clone commander revealed that most his troopers were killed as well as expressing his irritation over the lieutenant's late arrival without a notice. Sending Hexx and Veetch to get the lieutenant situated, Mayday remained to acquaint himself with Crosshair by speaking of his annoyance of Nolan, the latter of whom explained he knew the officer for about two [[Standard hour|hours]]. Both revealing their names to each other, the two left the depot to give Crosshair the lay of the land. Mayday told his assignment on Barton IV protecting the cargo for the past [[Standard year|year]], and had hoped its off-world transportation would allow he and his [[squad]] to leave. Asking who was attacking the depot and the contents of the crates, finding out that it had been local raiders supposedly bypassing the degraded [[sensor]]s, Mayday explained that it was above his pay grade to view the cargo. Telling Crosshair to be paired if scouting and to not travel far, as the temperatures or inhabitants would kill him, Veetch contacted the commander that raiders were attacking from within the depot's perimeters. Mayday headed to the west while Crosshair took the east side, wanting to flank the raiders. As Crosshair took position in a watchtower, Hexx reported over comms that Veetch had been killed and that three raiders were approaching the shuttle. After blowing up the shuttle and killing Hexx in the explosion, the raiders departed with a [[snow skiff]] carrying two crates. After the explosion, Crosshair pursued an injured raider himself. Entering a dug-in [[cave]], Mayday came up behind and told Crosshair that they took off down the western ridge. Mayday believed the attackers had fled into the [[mountain]]s until he realized they used the cave to bypass the Imperial defenses. Honoring the two deceased troopers, with Mayday being the only member left of his squad, Nolan ordered Mayday to send Hexx and Veetch to retrieve the stolen cargo when the commander revealed they were killed in the attack, and that they lacked manpower and equipment for a retrieval mission beyond the perimeter. Asking for Nolan's troopers for the mission, the lieutenant disagreed and ordered Mayday and Crosshair to recover the cargo themselves. ===Tracking the cargo=== {{Quote|We've been risking our lives to recover equipment we could have been wearing this whole time?|Mayday, to Crosshair|}} [[File:Mayday_disarming_a_mine.png|thumb|250x250px|Mayday disarms a pressure mine to save Crosshair.]] Following the [[blood]] trail left from one of the raiders, Crosshair and Mayday entered a [[cave]] system. While traversing the caves, Crosshair stepped on a [[pressure mine]], but Mayday assured him that it could be disabled before it exploded. As he worked on disarming the mine, Mayday expressed his dissatisfaction with the Empire's treatment of the clones, and considered the mission to guard the depot and its cargo to be menial. After disarming the mine, the duo came across the raiders' camp. After silently taking out two sentries, the two Imperials opened fire on the camp as the raiders were gathered around a fire. After managing to dispatch the raiders, Mayday looked upon the stolen cargo and realized that it contained supplies for the ever-prevalent [[TK stormtrooper]]s, who were intended to be the eventual replacements for clone stormtroopers after the passing of the [[Imperial Defense Recruitment Bill]]. Mayday expressed his shock that his squad had spent over a year protecting equipment that they could have worn, before reflecting on the sacrifices that the clones had made for both the Republic and the Empire. Before the supplies could be collected, however, an avalanche, caused by the explosion in the raiders’ camp, buried Crosshair and Mayday despite their attempt to flee. Crosshair quickly recovered and managed to dig Mayday, who was now weak and injured, out of the snow. Though Mayday told Crosshair to leave, he instead lifted the commander out of the snow, and the two weakly started going back to the Imperial depot. ===Death=== {{Quote|He... He needs a medic.''"
"''I see you didn't retrieve the crates, which means you've failed your mission.''"
"''Did you hear what I said? Help him!''"
"''Certainly not. That would be a waste of the Empire's resources.''"
"''He'll... He'll die.|Crosshair and Nolan, as Mayday dies|}} [[File:Mayday_dies.png|thumb|250px|Mayday dying as Crosshair begs Lieutenant Nolan for medical support.|left]] As night fell, Crosshair and Mayday collapsed behind a rock and huddled together in an attempt to stay warm. Stranded, Mayday's condition worsened throughout the night. By morning, the blizzard had calmed, and Crosshair and Mayday approached the Imperial depot, now garrisoned entirely by [[TK stormtrooper]]s. Upon noticing the arrival of the clones, Nolan denied Mayday [[medic]]al attention despite Crosshair's pleas, as he believed it would be a waste of Imperial resources. As Mayday succumbed to his injuries and died in front of the two, Nolan proclaimed that the clone had fulfilled his service as a soldier to the Empire before he reminded Crosshair that, as a clone, he was expendable. Nolan further demanded that Crosshair return to work and threatened that the commando would meet a similar fate as Mayday if he spoke out of turn. Angered, Crosshair shot and killed Nolan before falling unconscious as a group of TK stormtroopers rushed over to disarm him. ===Legacy=== At least six months later, Crosshair would return to Barton IV after escaping from Imperial imprisonment at [[Mount Tantiss]] on the planet [[Wayland]] and reuniting with his former squad, [[Clone Force 99]]. As his squad members searched the now-abandoned and partially buried depot for information regarding [[Tantiss Base|Tantiss]], Crosshair came across Mayday's [[helmet]], which had been discarded in a corner along with the helmets of his men. Crosshair picked up Mayday's helmet and stared at it wordlessly before placing it on a supply crate, after briefly pausing to look at his brother’s helmet once more, Crosshair picked up and arranged the helmets of Hexx and Veetch, along with the other clone helmets, in an effort to recreate the small memorial that Mayday had previously set up for his deceased men.{{TBB|The Return}} ==Personality and traits== [[File:Mayday-armor.png|thumb|right|180px|Clone Commander Mayday in his disheveled Phase II armor.]] {{Quote|After all the clones have done… all we sacrificed. We're good soldiers. We followed orders. And for what?|Mayday|}} As a clone of bounty hunter Jango Fett, Mayday was a human male with [[Color|tan]] skin, overgrown black [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s. As a clone [[trooper]], he stood 1.83 [[meter]]s tall. Though Mayday was loyal to the Galactic Empire, he considered the mission to guard the Imperial depot on Barton IV to be menial and was especially unsatisfied with the Empire's treatment of clones. Mayday cared greatly for the troopers under his command, and kept the helmets of his deceased squad mates displayed inside the Imperial depot. ==Equipment== As a clone stormtrooper, Mayday was equipped with standard-issue [[Phase II clone trooper armor]]. After a year of being stationed on Barton IV, Mayday's armor was disheveled and supplemented with various fabrics to combat the weather conditions. The voice filter on Mayday’s helmet was also muffled due to the lack of proper maintenance. He armed himself with a [[DC-15A blaster carbine]], which was equipped with a [[glowrod]]. He also carried a small [[Hammer (tool)|hammer]] to disarm pressure mines, which he learned despite lacking the proper equipment to do so. ==Behind the scenes== As it can be unclear what real world terminology is "allowed" to be used as in-universe language within ''[[Star Wars]]'' material,{{Bluesky|username=infinata.bsky.social|url=post/3lmiisghqsk2n|name=[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2025-04-10|quote=Editing the Star Wars-iness of text is an idiosyncratic art and not a defined science. I balk at the use of “footage” due to its outdated terrestrial origins, but we’ve all given “cockpit” a pass because it’s so grandfathered in.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/a1m1v}} Lore Advisor [[Pablo Hidalgo]] was unsure for a period of time as to whether Mayday could be given his name.{{Bluesky|username=infinata.bsky.social|url=post/3lmndaeu5ik2p|name=[[Pablo Hidalgo]]|date=2025-04-12|quote=You have no idea how much I stewed over the idea of a clone trooper named Mayday.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/pTAMt}} ==Appearances== *{{TBB|The Outpost}} {{1st}} *{{TBB|The Return}} {{C|Helmet only}} ==Sources== *{{ThisWeek|LMp0i8tw_L4|From a Certain Point of View Cover Reveal, Star Wars Celebration LIVE!, and More!|sw_url=video/from-a-certain-point-of-view-cover-reveal-star-wars-celebration-live-and-more}} *{{InsiderCite|223|Star Wars: The Bad Batch Season Two Companion|''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season Two Companion}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' *{{Databank|clone-commander-mayday|Clone Commander Mayday}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Mayday |fr=Mayday |ja=メーデー |ka=მეიდეი |nl=Mayday }} [[Category:Clone stormtrooper officers of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Clone trooper commanders]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
